title: 第21章 顶级天赋引气成第22章 宗门耻辱斩逆徒
content_zh:
;;
李观棋刚刚睁开眼睛就发现蓝禾还有殿中的弟子都在看向他。
而且眼神都像是看怪物一样。
他自己也知道是怎么回事，干脆就坦然面对了。
不过是引气成功，突破到了炼气一层而已，没什么好大惊小怪的。
他按照引气口诀上面的去做，没过一会他就进入了一种十分玄妙的状态中。
他仿佛置身于天地之间，周围有很多彩色的光点。
这些光点里面，只有紫色的光点受到他的牵引融入他的体内。
现在他只觉得通体舒坦，就是这身上黏腻杂质让他有些受不了。
况且这东西还散发着难闻无比的恶臭味。
蓝禾微微一笑，轻声道：“这些东西都是我们体内的杂质，修仙入道，会渐渐排除体内这些杂质。”
“你就先回去收拾一下吧，其他人这会可以看一下面前的锻体功法以及引气口诀。”
“有什么问题可以直接问我。”
李观棋本想第一堂课就直接离开有些不太好，但身上的臭味实在让他有些无法忍受。
和蓝禾告罪一声便往天雷峰赶去。
刚走到天雷峰脚下，就看到一位老者在盘膝打坐。
察觉到他来了之后立马睁开了眼睛，李南廷看向李观棋震惊的说道。
“你小子这是突破到炼气境了？？”
“你不是在上课么？怎么就突破了？”
李观棋挠了挠头，有些尴尬的说道：“在课上就突破了，这不…弄得一身狼狈。”

听闻此话李南廷不禁哈哈大笑，朗声笑道：“哈哈，不愧是我徒弟啊。”
“大夏剑宗历史上还没有谁在第一堂课上就直接突破的。”
“走，我带你回去。”
李南廷抓起少年便御空而行。
沿途也碰到了不少天雷峰的弟子在练功，看到浑身黢黑的李观棋都是微微一愣。
顾冉放下手中剑，用手肘怼了怼身旁的大高个，低声呢喃道。
“我没看错吧？师弟今儿不是刚去天水峰听课么？”
“怎么就…突破了？？？”
大高个也是有点懵，呢喃道：“小师弟这天赋未免也有些太逆天了吧？”
“按理来说第一堂课不应该是蓝长老讲解一些初入仙门的知识么？”
没过多久，天雷峰弟子李观棋在第一堂课上直接突破到炼气一层的消息不胫而走。
一时间天才之名已经不足以形容李观棋。
这才是真正的妖孽之姿！！
而其他新入门的弟子，还在苦苦追求锻体境能够单手举起百斤石碾。
这位已经突破到炼气一层了。
回到房间洗了个澡，李观棋终于是感觉自己活了过来。
光是洗澡水他都换了三次，皮都搓红了，这才感觉好多了。
走出房间的李观棋发现师父并没有走，而且桌子上还放着几个玉瓶和灵石。
李南廷眼底露出一抹骄傲之色，示意李观棋坐在身旁。
他也没扭捏，走到老者身旁坐了下来。

老者眼神欣慰的看着少年，随后轻声道：“蓝禾可是和你们讲了灵墟和命氏？”
见少年点头，老者抬头望向天空轻声道：“灵墟之事，乃是出生之时便早已注定，有或没有都一样，并不影响你的修道之路。”
“既然你已经一只脚踏入了仙道，那今日为师便给你讲一讲接下来的修炼。”
李观棋面色一肃，不自觉的坐直了身体。
“炼气期一共分为十层，前三层炼内腑、中三层炼经脉、后三层炼神。”

As soon as Li Guanqi opened his eyes, he found that Lan He and the disciples in the temple were looking at him.
And his eyes were like looking at a monster.
He himself knew what was going on, so he simply faced it calmly.
It's just a matter of successfully entraining Qi and breaking through to the first level of Qi refining. There's nothing to make a fuss about.
He followed the Qi-entraining formula, and after a while he entered a very mysterious state.
He seemed to be between heaven and earth, with many colorful light spots around him.
Among these light spots, only the purple ones were drawn by him and integrated into his body.
Now he just felt comfortable all over, but it was the sticky impurities on his body that made him a little unbearable.
Moreover, this thing also exudes an extremely unpleasant stench.
Lan He smiled slightly and said softly: "These things are all impurities in our body. By cultivating immortality and entering Taoism, these impurities will gradually be eliminated from the body."
"You should go back and tidy up first. Others can take a look at the body-building exercises and Qi-entraining formulas in front of them."
"If you have any questions, you can ask me directly."
Li Guanqi thought it would be a bad idea to leave immediately after the first class, but the stench on his body was really unbearable.
He and Lan He confessed and rushed to Tianlei Peak.
As soon as I reached the foot of Tianlei Peak, I saw an old man sitting cross-legged and meditating.
After noticing his arrival, Li Nanting immediately opened his eyes. Li Nanting looked at Li Guanqi and said in shock.
"Has your kid broken through to the Qi Refining Realm??"
"Aren't you in class? Why did you break through?"
Li Guanqi scratched his head and said with some embarrassment: "I broke through in class. This makes me... very embarrassed."
Hearing this, Li Nanting couldn't help laughing, and said with a loud laugh: "Haha, you are indeed my apprentice."
"In the history of Daxia Sword Sect, no one has made a breakthrough directly in the first class."
"Let's go, I'll take you back."
Li Nanting grabbed the boy and flew into the air.
Along the way, I also met many disciples of Tianleifeng practicing their martial arts. They were slightly startled when they saw Li Guanqi, who was covered in black.
Gu Ran put down his sword, hit the tall man next to him with his elbow, and murmured in a low voice.
"Am I right? Didn't Junior Brother just go to Tianshui Peak to attend a class today?"
"Why...breakthrough???"
The tall man was also a little confused, and murmured: "My junior brother, this talent is a bit too unnatural, isn't it?"
"Logically speaking, shouldn't the first class be Elder Lan explaining some knowledge for newbies to the Immortal Sect?"
Not long after, the news spread like wildfire that Tianlei Peak disciple Li Guanqi had directly broken through to the first level of Qi Refining in the first class.
For a time, the name of genius was no longer enough to describe Li Guanqi.
This is the true appearance of an evil spirit! !
Other new disciples are still struggling to reach the body-forging realm to be able to lift a hundred kilograms of stone with one hand.
This person has already broken through to the first level of Qi refining.
After returning to the room and taking a shower, Li Guanqi finally felt like he was alive.
He had to change the bath water three times, and his skin turned red from rubbing, and then he felt better.
Li Guanqi walked out of the room and found that the master had not left, and there were several jade bottles and spiritual stones on the table.
There was a hint of pride in Li Nanting's eyes, and he motioned for Li Guanqi to sit next to him.
He didn't hesitate, walked over to the old man and sat down.
The old man looked at the young man with pleased eyes, and then said softly: "Did Lan He tell you about Lingxu and Mingshi?"
Seeing the young man nodding, the old man looked up to the sky and whispered softly: "The matter of Lingxu was already determined when you were born. It doesn't matter whether it is present or not, it will not affect your path of cultivation."
"Since you have already stepped into the path of immortality, today my master will tell you about the next training."
Li Guanqi looked solemn and sat up straight unconsciously.
"The Qi refining period is divided into ten levels. The first three levels are for refining the internal organs, the middle three levels are for refining the meridians, and the last three levels are for refining the spirit."
